head: Rian Johnson's camera app gives iPhone photos a film look
dek: Chromagraph Camera, made by director Rian Johnson with cinematographer Steve Yedlin, shoots RAW photos and processes them with the color and grain techniques Yedlin developed for their films.
details: The look is applied after you take the photo and can be changed later, because the RAW original stays untouched; photos export as JPEG or HEIC. It costs $12.99 once and needs iOS 17 or later. MacRumors reported it at No. 1 in Photo & Video on the US App Store.
means: A one-time-purchase camera app for people who want film-style photos without editing each one by hand.
todo: Search for Chromagraph Camera in the App Store, and check that your iPhone runs iOS 17 or later first.
